description: August 11 birthday meaning: Leo decan 2, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 11 birthday falls in Leo, in the second decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of an August 11 birthday
paragraphs: Master number 11, kept whole, gives the 11th of August an inspired, intuitive edge. Eighteen degrees into Leo, Jupiter's decan broadens that inspiration into big ideas about meaning and purpose. Interpretive traditions describe a magnetic idealist who can rally people around a vision. Grounding practices help translate the vision into daily, practical steps.

By noon UTC on August 11, the Sun has normally reached roughly 18° of Leo. That places the date in the Leo decan that astrologers give to Jupiter, the second of three. Jupiter, the planet of Sagittarius, acts as sub-ruler for Leo from 10 to 19 degrees, which covers roughly the first ten days of August. This decan tends to add breadth and humour to the Lion's confidence. Natives are commonly pictured as big-hearted teachers, hosts and storytellers who like to share what they know and enjoy. A love of travel, ideas and grand plans often shows early. Jupiter magnifies, so the generosity can become overpromising and the confidence a little too sure of itself. When grounded, this decan tends to inspire others to think larger about their own lives.

sections.heading: Numerology of the August 11 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same August 11 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 2 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 22 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: August 11 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 11 is the 223rd day of the year (224th in a leap year). In most years Virgo season is under way by August 23, 12 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 11 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. August 11 is also the birthday of Pervez Musharraf (1943), Edgar de Wahl (1867) and Steve Wozniak (1950).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 11?
faq.answer: August 11 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Leo, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 11 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 2 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 22 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 11?
faq.answer: By August 11 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 11?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an August 11 birthday are Pervez Musharraf (1943), Edgar de Wahl (1867) and Steve Wozniak (1950). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
